about.description: Reel Surprise Charters is a family-owned brand of Orange Beach fishing charters and boutique marina services, located at SanRoc Cay. Founded in 1999 by Randy Boggs and Susan, they operate a 65' Bonner head boat and offer inshore and offshore fishing charters. The marina features 54 premium boat slips, a fully-stocked dock store with fuel, shopping, restaurants, clean restroom facilities, and more. They provide bilingual crew services and have over 20 years of experience on the Gulf Coast.
about.elevator_pitch: Family-owned fishing charters and boutique marina in Orange Beach with spacious vessels, expert local crew, and premium marina services since 1999.
about.vibe: Family-friendly, locally-loved, welcoming to all experience levels, with experienced captains and deckhands who treat guests like family.
about.capacity: Head boat up to 35 passengers | Inshore charters up to 4 passengers | Six-passenger charters up to 6 passengers
about.departure_location: SanRoc Cay Marina, Orange Beach, AL
about.insider_tip: Reel Surprise Marina is the closest to the Gulf, meaning less travel time and more fishing time. They offer a Frequent Fishing Program with discounted rates for repeat customers.

features: Located at SanRoc Cay shopping/dining district

specials.name: Frequent Fishing Program
specials.description: First 8 trips: $100 per trip | 9th trip: $50 | 10th trip: FREE. Includes fishing license, fishing tackle, and bait. Targeted species: Vermillion Snapper and Lane Snapper.

specials.name: Short Term Slip Rentals
specials.description: 30 day minimum at $750 per month. Accommodates up to 42' boats. Includes water. Power metered separately. No liveaboards.

specials.name: 68' x 20' Boat Slip
specials.description: Premium slip with water and storage shed included. Power metered separately. No liveaboards.

specials.name: Gift Cards
specials.description: Gift cards now available in customizable amounts. Can be sent via email.

packages.name: Reel Surprise Fishing Charter
packages.description: Group fishing charter aboard the 65' Bonner head boat with air-conditioned cabin, two restrooms, and 35-passenger limit. Plenty of space to reel in memories. Perfect for families and first-timers.
packages.price_note: Best price in town for walk-on/head boat
packages.notes: Limited passenger capacity for room to reel. Walk-on charters available.

packages.name: Inshore Fishing Charter
packages.description: Inshore charter fishing perfect for beginners and pros. Fish along calm and scenic waters of Orange Beach coastline. Target species include redfish, speckled trout, Spanish mackerel, and cobia.
packages.notes: All ages welcome. Variety of fishing styles available.

packages.name: Six-Passenger Private Charter
packages.description: Private fishing charter for up to 6 guests. Keep what you catch (as long as in season and legal). Perfect for families, small groups, and corporate teams.
packages.notes: All ages welcome. Private charter experience with expert crew.

packages.name: Marina Slip Rental - Premium
packages.description: Premium boat slip rental at Reel Surprise Marina with 54 total slips. Full-service amenities including high-speed fuel pumps, clean restrooms and showers, fish-cleaning stations, and dock store access.
packages.notes: Power metered separately. Accommodates up to 42' boats. Located at SanRoc Cay with shopping and dining access.

packages.name: Dock Store - Supplies
packages.description: Fully-stocked dock store offering snacks, bait, gear, and fishing supplies.
packages.notes: Located at SanRoc Cay with boutique shops and restaurants nearby.
